primary_invariants: atomic task status plus event persistence
container and ingest events scoped by current attempt/container
single active worker per task and role
classification plus recovery mutation guarded by same-state predicates
best-effort fanout isolated from authoritative state changes

findings.invariant: Plan approval is exactly-once.
findings.acceptance_test: Concurrent approve for one plan-review task creates one subtask set and returns one 409.

findings.invariant: A container event mutates only the matching current attempt/container.
findings.acceptance_test: Deliver old container death after reassignment and assert current worker remains assigned.

findings.invariant: Recovery preserves lifecycle role.
findings.acceptance_test: Parametrize dead role/status and assert replacement role is correct.

findings.invariant: Merge result side effects are scoped to current attempt.
findings.acceptance_test: Old merge result arriving after retry is ignored.

findings.invariant: Reconciler never commits from stale host worktree.
findings.acceptance_test: Advanced bare ref plus stale host worktree does not create revert commit.

findings.invariant: Live container has durable DB identity or is destroyed.
findings.acceptance_test: DB failure after spawn destroys container or records recovery state.

findings.invariant: At most one active worker per task and role.
findings.acceptance_test: Concurrent typed spawn starts only one container.

findings.invariant: Stale gate conflicts return 409.
findings.acceptance_test: Status changes between precheck and delegate maps to 409.

findings.invariant: Lifecycle DB mutations are atomic or compensated.
findings.acceptance_test: Failure injection after side-row creation leaves no partial transition.

findings.invariant: Archive never cancels live assigned work.
findings.acceptance_test: Assignment becomes live between check and update; archive returns 409.

findings.invariant: Recovery clears only the assignment classified safe.
findings.acceptance_test: Reassignment or heartbeat after classification prevents apply.

findings.invariant: Accepted heartbeat updates authoritative liveness.
findings.acceptance_test: Heartbeat ingest advances Agent.HeartbeatAt and blocks stale recovery.

findings.invariant: Parent-child retry is atomic or conflict-safe.
findings.acceptance_test: Retry failed child under failed parent leaves both in intended states or no mutation.

findings.invariant: Shutdown drains final lifecycle logs.
findings.acceptance_test: Final merge_result survives die/cancel race.

findings.invariant: List failure is not death evidence.
findings.acceptance_test: ListWorkers error plus seen container does not mark worker dead.

findings.invariant: Merge retries obey backoff.
findings.acceptance_test: Tick before retry delay does not spawn merger.

findings.invariant: Concurrent branch ensure is idempotent.
findings.acceptance_test: Two EnsureBranch calls for same ref both reach desired end state.

findings.invariant: Live worker branch has one matching active owner.
findings.acceptance_test: Gitref already-active error prevents or destroys spawned container.

findings.invariant: Concurrent register cannot duplicate ports.
findings.acceptance_test: Concurrent project adds produce distinct ports or conflict.

findings.invariant: Whole-file registry saves serialize or detect stale writes.
findings.acceptance_test: Two stale saves cannot lose one project.

findings.invariant: ListWorkers is restart-aware or marked unsafe for destructive recovery.
findings.acceptance_test: Spawner restart recovers labeled running containers or exposes cold start.

findings.invariant: Shutdown has bounded, reconciled in-flight operations.
findings.acceptance_test: Cancel during create/start leaves no orphan or records unknown outcome.

findings.invariant: One slow client cannot block hub delivery/mutation.
findings.acceptance_test: Blocked writer does not block broadcast beyond deadline.

findings.invariant: Delivery claim is atomic.
findings.acceptance_test: Concurrent poll/deliver produces one claimed delivery.

findings.invariant: Persona transitions serialize per service.
findings.acceptance_test: Overlapping stop/recreate returns 409 or queues deterministically.

findings.invariant: Status transition plus event append is atomic compare-and-swap.
findings.acceptance_test: Conflicting transitions produce one event and one conflict.

findings.invariant: Every status is modeled explicitly.
findings.acceptance_test: All task statuses have transition-map entries.

findings.invariant: Comments belong to existing tasks.
findings.acceptance_test: Concurrent delete/comment cannot create orphan.

findings.invariant: Concurrent item processing returns conflict/not-found, not 500.
findings.acceptance_test: Parallel archive/ignore gives one success and one 404/409.

findings.invariant: Archive never overwrites existing record.
findings.acceptance_test: Destination collision is refused or made unique.

findings.invariant: Cursor pagination visits every message once.
findings.acceptance_test: Same-timestamp page traversal returns all IDs.

findings.invariant: 2xx body contract is explicit.
findings.acceptance_test: 204 or empty 200 behavior is tested.

findings.invariant: Recovery applies only to intended statuses.
findings.acceptance_test: Terminal assigned task recovery is no-op/rejected/documented.

findings.invariant: Replacement cap survives restart or is documented best-effort.
findings.acceptance_test: Restart does not reset cap silently.

findings.invariant: HTTP response latency is decoupled from fanout.
findings.acceptance_test: POST returns promptly with blocked websocket.

findings.invariant: Ack preserves first acknowledgement timestamp.
findings.acceptance_test: Second ack does not change acked_at.

findings.invariant: Start does not implicitly recreate unless documented.
findings.acceptance_test: Start command is compose start or action is renamed/documented.

findings.invariant: Registry preserves merge outcome after deletion.
findings.acceptance_test: Successful merge leaves durable merged-deleted outcome.

findings.invariant: Register same content URI is concurrency-idempotent.
findings.acceptance_test: Concurrent register succeeds with one row.

findings.invariant: Artifact has one current superseder unless conflict-modeled.
findings.acceptance_test: Concurrent supersede to different targets yields one conflict.

findings.invariant: Tests and fakes match production transition contract.
findings.acceptance_test: POST /fail real-orchestrator test asserts production status.

open_verification_gaps: No dynamic race tests were run for this artifact.
Production DB constraints and SQLite/GORM transaction settings were not fully verified.
Foreign-key enforcement for task comments was not confirmed.
Lifecycle-engine mode needs a separate equivalent-protection pass.
Docker status semantics for restart/paused/removing/dead need runtime validation.
Container sighting probe wiring in production was not confirmed.
